=== association class
class A
class B
class C
A -- B
(A, B) .. C
=== association class reversed
class A
class B
class C
A -- B
C .. (A, B)
=== association class without link
class A
class B
class C
(A, B) .. C : label

=== association with note
class A

=== association quoted
class "A x" as A
class B

("A", "B") .. C
=== diamond
<> diamond1
class A
class B
A -- diamond1
diamond1 -- B
=== diamond exists
class d
<> d
=== lollipops
class A
A ()- I1
A ()-- I2
I3 -() A
I4 --() A
A -(( I5
I6 ))- A
I7 ))-- A
=== lollipops labels
class A
A "x" ()- "y" I1 : label
A ()- I2 : "a" label "b"
A ()- I3 : "a" label
A ()- I4 : label "b"
@2 A ()- I5
=== lollipop no class
I1 -() Unknown
=== lollipop horizontal count
class A
A ()- I1
A ()- I2
A ()- I3
=== lollipop with keyword
class A
interface B
class A ()- I1
interface B -() I2
